name: Slideshow Horizontal Stretch

contents: Scroll hint text with previous and next round arrow buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer drag move to the previous or next slide through GSAP Observer
Outgoing image stretches on the x axis while sliding out, incoming image shrinks from stretched to normal
Loops from last slide to first
Input is ignored while a transition runs

Transition duration, easing and stretch amount
Wheel sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and colors, hint text
